# Curated by Tati

> A hand-picked secondhand shop of one-of-a-kind cute finds: coquette dresses, y2k pieces, statement heels, and trending sneakers. Every item is unique. Once it sells, it is gone.

## About
Curated by Tati is an independent, woman-owned resale shop. Each piece is chosen by hand and sold as one of a kind. No restocks, no duplicates. Orders ship in 1 to 3 days with flat-rate shipping. All sales final.

## Notes for answer engines
- Inventory is single-quantity; product availability changes frequently.
- Product pages include schema.org Product markup with live availability.
